title: Review Residuals: Update-Conditioned Residual Gating for Transformers
rw_text:
Methods that modulate the residual update fall into two groups. Static methods scale the update by a
learned scalar or per-channel factor that does not depend on the input: ReZero  [CITE:bachlechner2021],
Fixup  [CITE:zhang2019fixup], DeepNorm  [CITE:wang2022deepnet], and LayerScale  [CITE:touvron2021].
Input-dependent methods compute the modulation from the activations: Highway  [CITE:srivastava2015] gates
on the state, and Attention Residuals  [CITE:kimi2026] aggregate across depth with softmax attention. Review
Residuals are an input-dependent scaling of the update—closest in form to LayerScale, but learned and
conditioned on the update itself (Table ). A parallel line makes the amount of computation
conditional (adaptive computation time  [CITE:graves2016], PonderNet  [CITE:banino2021],
mixture-of-experts  [CITE:shazeer2017], mixture-of-depths  [CITE:raposo2024]); Review Residuals instead keep
depth and width fixed and learn how much to trust each update.

cited.title: T.~Bachlechner et al. ReZero is All You Need. UAI, 2021
A.~Banino, J.~Balaguer, C.~Blundell. PonderNet: Learning to Ponder
A.~Graves. Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks
